register.en: Address the user as 'you' in a clear, friendly-professional tone; buttons are short imperative verbs ('Save', 'Add field'); use sentence case for every title, menu item and button, never Title Case; US spelling.
register.de: Address the user formally with 'Sie' (Ihr, Ihnen), never 'du'; buttons use the infinitive ('Speichern', 'Feld hinzufügen'); sentence-style capitalization apart from regular German noun capitalization; neutral, precise tone.
register.es: Address the user informally with 'tú' in a neutral, professional tone; buttons use the infinitive ('Guardar', 'Añadir campo'); sentence case; standard vocabulary as in Spain ('Añadir', 'Eliminar', 'Archivo').
register.it: Address the user informally with 'tu' in a friendly, professional tone; buttons use the second-person imperative ('Salva', 'Aggiungi campo'); sentence case.
register.pt-BR: Address the user as 'você' in a friendly, professional tone; buttons use the infinitive ('Salvar', 'Adicionar campo'); sentence case; Brazilian vocabulary ('Excluir', 'Arquivo', 'Senha').
register.nl: Address the user informally with 'je/jouw', never 'u'; buttons use the infinitive ('Opslaan', 'Veld toevoegen'); sentence case; direct, friendly tone.
register.pl: Address the user with the informal second-person singular (ty forms, pronoun left implicit where possible), never 'Pan/Pani'; buttons use the imperative ('Zapisz', 'Dodaj pole'); sentence case.
register.cs: Address the user formally with 'vy' (lowercase, verb forms such as 'Uložte'), never 'ty'; buttons use the infinitive ('Uložit', 'Přidat pole'); sentence case.
register.sv: Address the user as 'du' in a plain, friendly tone; buttons use the imperative ('Spara', 'Lägg till fält'); sentence case.
register.da: Address the user as 'du' in a plain, friendly tone; buttons use the imperative ('Gem', 'Tilføj felt'); sentence case.
register.nb: Address the user as 'du' in Bokmål with a plain, friendly tone; buttons use the imperative ('Lagre', 'Legg til felt'); sentence case.
register.fi: Address the user in the informal singular carried by the verb forms, without the pronoun 'sinä'; buttons use the imperative ('Tallenna', 'Lisää kenttä'); sentence case; concise, neutral tone.
register.ro: Address the user formally with 'dumneavoastră' (second-person plural verbs, e.g. 'Salvați modificările'); buttons use the formal imperative ('Salvați', 'Adăugați câmp'); sentence case; always write ș and ț with the comma below.
register.hu: Address the user formally with 'Ön' forms, leaving the pronoun implicit where possible; buttons use action nouns ('Mentés', 'Mező hozzáadása'); sentence case.
register.tr: Address the user formally with 'siz' forms in sentences ('Değişikliklerinizi kaydedin'); buttons use the short imperative ('Kaydet', 'Alan ekle'); sentence case, respecting the dotted and dotless i.
register.uk: Address the user formally with 'ви' (lowercase); buttons use the infinitive ('Зберегти', 'Додати поле'); sentence case; follow the current orthography ('проєкт').
register.ja: Use the polite です/ます form for sentences and never 'あなた'; buttons and menu items are noun-style labels ('保存', 'フィールドを追加'); full-width Japanese punctuation with half-width Latin letters and digits.
register.zh-CN: Address the user as '您' only when a pronoun is needed, in a concise, professional tone; buttons are short verbs ('保存', '添加字段'); full-width Chinese punctuation, with a space between Chinese and Latin letters or digits.
register.ko: Use the formal polite 합니다 style for sentences and never '당신'; buttons and menu items are noun-style labels ('저장', '필드 추가'); standard Korean spacing.
